entries.title: Loren starts doing things — orchestrator + live Property Search
bullets: Built the orchestrator: Loren now uses real tool-calling to decide what to do, not keyword tricks.
First live capability — Property Search — runs a real query against our listings and returns matches.
Added a metering ledger that records every run (what she did, how long, credits) — live tables applied.
Front-end hook wired so the ask bar can call her. Note: the function deploys through our normal pipeline on merge.
entries.bench: 1 orchestrator function · 1 live capability · 3 additive tables live · metering ledger · PR #158

entries.title: Custom link updates.1propertymarket.com — one toggle left
bullets: DNS + domain file are set. To finish: in the loren-os-progress repo → Settings → Pages → Source: main → Save. GitHub then issues the HTTPS certificate automatically (a few minutes).
Until then the certificate warning is expected; use the githack link (works now over HTTPS).
entries.bench: A-record + CNAME committed · awaiting GitHub Pages enable

entries.title: Live orb + drag carousels + conversation memory
bullets: Built the animated Loren orb (idle / listening / thinking / speaking) — reacts when you click the ask bar.
Tool tiles became a real carousel: drag, swipe, or scroll on any device.
